Assuming standard dimensions for a pear, the mass is estimated at 0.2 kg. For collision geometry in Isaac Sim, 'convex_decomposition' is highly recommended; a simple convex hull would incorrectly bridge the gap between the top of the stem and the bulbous base, resulting in an unnaturally large collision volume that would cause the pear to float or roll incorrectly. Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) is disabled as this object is typically used in low-velocity manipulation scenarios.
